description: This file declares functions related to WiFi MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) management, including fetching, selecting, and reconfiguring SSIDs, for a WiFi plugin component.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_fetchSockLinkSSID
methods.description: Fetches the SSID linked to a socket name using the WPA control manager.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_selectPrimLinkSSID
methods.description: Selects the primary link SSID from a given SSID.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_reconfigureNeighLinkSSIDs
methods.description: Reconfigures neighboring link SSIDs based on the provided SSID.
